statements.subject: message
statements.description: A message body containing a description of media capabilities MAY be present in the response, which is formatted according to the Accept header field in the INVITE (or application/sdp if not present), the same as a message body in a 200 (OK) response to an OPTIONS request.
actions: optionally include message body describing media capabilities formatted per Accept header field in INVITE or application/sdp if Accept not present
